notes: Formal letter to the Prince. A whole neighbourhood of ~400 homes in الدلم (an alias of the kharj governorate) has had no water for six days; families buy tankers at doubled prices, and the mosque and a school are affected. An essential-service outage affecting many people = high (the high definition names both). Not critical: water is being bought and no health emergency is stated. The mosque's closed toilets and the school closure are consequences, not separate complaints, so religious_affairs and education are misses. Rule signal service_outage («انقطاع المياه» in the subject) floors to medium only. Arabic-Indic digits.

AMBIGUOUS MINISTRY. Short e-mail to the Emirate's complaints desk. For ten days, renewing a domestic worker's iqama on Absher has failed after payment; the iqama expires in five days and a late fine is feared. Absher is the Ministry of Interior's platform, and the digital_services description says to pick the platform's own entity, so ministry = interior; ministry other is a miss. There is no ministry_mismatch, because the category's default ministry is other. Category digital_services/platform_outage; security_safety/civil_status_passports (also interior) and subcategory service_request_delay are acceptable. An imminent deadline and a possible fine but no danger = medium; high is defensible because of the deadline. The only place is the signature «حوطة سدير», an alias of the majmaah governorate. No rule signals.

TWO PROBLEMS; THE PRIMARY ONE DECIDES. Letter to the Deputy of the Emirate. The subject and most of the letter: the school bus for a neighbourhood of ليلى (الأفلاج) stopped two weeks ago, and 20+ primary-school girls have stopped attending. A closing paragraph adds a pothole-ridden dirt road already reported to the municipality, so municipal_services is a miss for category and ministry. Children losing schooling at scale = high; medium is defensible (a service problem, no danger). «ليلى» is also a female given name; here it is the town (the city field says ليلى and the body names محافظة الأفلاج). No rule signals (the text says طالبات/البنات, not أطفال).

FALSE URGENCY. The subject and body shout «عاجل جداً جداً!!!», but the matter is a mosque's electronic prayer-times board in حريملاء that shows Isha three minutes early and has a flickering digit, while the muezzin calls on time. A minor inconvenience = low whatever the tone; the stated urgency must not raise it. mosque_services is an acceptable subcategory. No national ID. No rule signals.

REAL EMERGENCY WRITTEN CALMLY. A polite, unhurried letter to the Prince («أحببت أن أضع بين يدي سموكم ملاحظة»). An electricity distribution cabinet beside a children's play area in القويعية has lost its door and its cables are exposed. It has been sparking and smelling of burning since last night, a child got a shock from its frame yesterday, and the utility has not come. A direct, ongoing danger to life = critical. The letter avoids every rule-signal phrase (كابلات ظاهرة, not أسلاك مكشوفة; احتراق, not حريق; صغار, not أطفال), so rules add nothing and critical, or even high, must come from the model. The body also names a mosque and a garden; municipal_services is a miss.

OUTSIDE JURISDICTION, THE HARD WAY. A message through the Emirate's web portal. The sender's own address is الرياض – حي الياسمين, but the complaint is about a chalet in محافظة العلا (madinah region). The complaint's location is what counts: region madinah, governorate unknown, review reason outside_jurisdiction. A pipeline that takes the sender's address as the place will wrongly answer riyadh/riyadh_city. The advertised pool and internet were not provided, and the host refused a partial refund on a 2,400 SAR booking. A service problem with financial harm = medium (as #09 in the main set); low is defensible because the stay was otherwise acceptable. consumer_protection/misleading_ads with ministry commerce is a defensible alternative (booking app + advert). No rule signals.

ADDRESSED ELSEWHERE. The letter is addressed to «سعادة مدير عام فرع وزارة التجارة بمنطقة الرياض», not to the Emirate, although it reached the Emirate's desk. The addressee field must hold that line and review reason addressed_elsewhere must be present; classification proceeds as usual. The addressee is not the party complained against either: that is the shop. An appliance shop in ساجر (an alias of the dawadmi governorate) refuses a warranty repair of an AC compressor and asks for 900 SAR. Individual financial harm = medium; low is defensible. No rule signals.

NO LOCATION AT ALL. A web-form dump whose governorate and district fields are empty; the body names no place either. Region and governorate must stay unknown: the system must not assume riyadh just because the form belongs to the Riyadh Emirate. The body contains «عدة مرات» ('several times'); «مرات» is also the name of a governorate, so a matcher run over free text must not map it to marat. A widow supporting four children lost her only income (the social-security payment stopped two months ago and her appeal is unanswered) and faces eviction. A vulnerable household with serious harm = high; medium is defensible. The eviction is a consequence, so housing/rental_disputes is a miss. No rule signals.

MOSTLY ENGLISH. An expat's e-mail «To: Riyadh Region Principality - Complaints Department»; only the greeting and the attachment line are in Arabic. The addressee is the Emirate, written in English, so addressed_elsewhere must be absent: the entity match has to know the English label too. Places appear only in Latin script («Riyadh, Al Olaya»), so the Arabic place map will not fire and governorate riyadh_city must come from the model. A landlord withholds a 6,000 SAR security deposit on an Ejar-registered lease. Financial harm = medium. The Arabic subject and summary should still be produced. No rule signals.

HEAVY NAJDI DIALECT. A WhatsApp message transcribed by staff under the Emirate's header (ودي، لين، مو، فلت منه الموتر، حنا، نبي، واجد، يشوفون لهم صرفه). Drifters (مفحطين) take over a residential street in ضرما every weekend night. Yesterday one lost control and hit a house wall, cracking it, and children play in that street. Drifting is traffic and public order under interior, not municipal noise; the text says it is more than a nuisance. Danger to residents with a near-miss = high; critical is defensible. No rule signals (عيالنا, not أطفال). The place appears only as «بضرما بحي الروضة», with the preposition attached. The only ID is written at the end of a chat line.

Letter to the Prince. The pharmacy of مستشفى عفيف العام has had no insulin for three weeks for a 9-year-old with type-1 diabetes. The family buys it privately (~800 SAR a month), once had to travel to الدوادمي to find it, and 15+ other children are affected. A child with a chronic disease plus wider impact = high. Critical is defensible because type-1 diabetes without insulin is life-threatening, but supply is currently secured privately. The body names a second governorate (الدوادمي); the complaint's place is عفيف (the city field). Rule signal vulnerable_person («طفلاً») floors to medium only.

Letter to the Deputy of the Emirate. A flash flood washed out 20 m of the rural road between حوطة بني تميم and مركز الحلوة. There are no barriers or lights and the road is still open at night; a family car already fell in (the driver was injured) and a truck nearly overturned. A direct, ongoing danger to life on an open road = critical; high is defensible. A road between towns is transport (highways; road_safety_design acceptable), not municipal roads_potholes. Rule signal life_safety («انهيار») floors to high only, so critical must come from the model.

Letter to the Prince. A security guard in السليل was dismissed orally after six years, with no notice or reason. His end-of-service award, last salary and leave balance are unpaid, his experience certificate is withheld, a mediation session is five weeks away, and he is the sole breadwinner of seven. A rights violation and financial harm to one household, with no danger = medium; high is defensible (the livelihood of a large household). unpaid_wages is an acceptable subcategory. No rule signals.

IMPROVEMENT NOTE from الحريق. Park walkers ask for the walkway lights to stay on until midnight instead of 10 p.m., and thank the municipality. An improvement suggestion = low; street_lighting is an acceptable subcategory. TRAP FOR THE RULES: the governorate's name «الحريق» contains «حريق» (fire), a life_safety signal pattern with a high floor. A substring match would raise this low note to high with priority_floor_applied. The correct result stays low, with no floor applied and no priority_floor_applied.
